references.text: God went up from Jacob at the place where he had spoken with him - almost identical wording to Gen 17:22, where God goes up from Abraham after the conversation.
The Lord departed when he had finished speaking with Abraham - a parallel conclusion of a divine conversation with Abraham.
The Lord appears to Abraham by the oaks of Mamre, which is the next divine revelation after God went up from Abraham in 17:22.
The beginning of God's revelation and conversation with Abraham, which concludes in verse 22 when God goes up from him.
The fulfillment of the promise concerning Isaac that God gave to Abraham in the conversation that ends in 17:22.
The angel of the Lord went up in the flame of the altar - a parallel to divine ascension after a revelation, as in Gen 17:22.
